data.narrative:
Ares Industries is a Series A-stage frontier-tech company in Defense & Security founded by Alex Tseng and Devan Plantamura, with $31M raised to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 11 companies in the same sector and stage cohort, comprising 2 public comparables and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Castelion.

Two valuation methods were applied. The stage-progression method, using $31M total raised as a proxy for pre-money valuation, applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression, implying $62M. The peer-median method references 11 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $125M to $3.0B; the cohort median stands at $1.0B, with cited examples including Dream Security ($3.0B Series B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B Series B), and Harmattan AI ($1.4B Series B).

The triangulated analysis yields a low estimate of $53M, median of $531M, and high of $1.1B. The wide dispersion reflects material stage and scale heterogeneity within the peer set; early-stage Defense & Security companies show extreme valuation variance depending on technology readiness, customer traction, and regulatory pathway clarity. Key uncertainties include customer concentration, defense contract award probability, and whether Ares' specific technical differentiation commands a premium or discount relative to the median peer. A post-Series A valuation in the $250M–$750M range appears defensible pending revenue trajectory and customer validation.
